parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm at about 60 bpm with a normal PR interval and narrow QRS, left axis deviation, and very high voltage (S in V2 plus R in V5 is about 50 mm, and R in aVL is about 11 mm). The mild J-point elevation with tall T waves in V1–V3 is the usual repolarization pattern of LVH and does not meet STEMI criteria.
